name: offload-tasks
title: 基于强化学习的云边端任务卸载

api.adaptor: var body = payload.data || {}; var items = Array.isArray(body) ? body : (body.items || []); var total = Array.isArray(body) ? items.length : (body.total || 0); function targetText(v) { if (v === 'TERMINAL') return '终端'; if (v === 'EDGE') return '边缘云'; if (v === 'CLOUD') return '中心云'; return v || '-'; } function taskTypeText(v) { if (v === 'LOCAL_QUALITY_CHECK') return '轻量质检'; if (v === 'EDGE_INFERENCE') return '边缘推理'; if (v === 'CLOUD_BATCH_ANALYSIS') return '批量分析'; return v || '-'; } function executionStatusText(v) { if (v === 'STARTING') return '准备执行'; if (v === 'SUBMITTED') return '任务已提交'; if (v === 'RUNNING') return '执行中'; if (v === 'SUCCEEDED') return '执行成功'; if (v === 'FAILED') return '执行失败'; return v || '已决策'; } items = items.map(function(item) { return {...item, taskTypeText: taskTypeText(item.taskType), decisionTargetText: targetText(item.decisionTarget), inputSizeText: (item.inputSizeMb || 0) + ' MB', deadlineText: (item.deadlineMs || '-') + ' ms', terminalLoadText: 'CPU ' + (item.terminalCpuLoad || 0) + '% / 内存 ' + (item.terminalMemoryLoad || 0) + '%', edgeContextText: '负载 ' + (item.edgeLoad || 0) + '% / 时延 ' + (item.edgeLatencyMs || 0) + ' ms', centerContextText: '负载 ' + (item.centerLoad || 0) + '% / 时延 ' + (item.centerLatencyMs || 0) + ' ms', decisionLatencyText: (item.decisionLatencyMs || '-') + ' ms', executeStatusText: executionStatusText(item.executeStatus)}; }); return {...payload, status: payload.status === 200 ? 0 : payload.status, msg: payload.message, data: {items: items, total: total}};

api.adaptor: var data = payload.data || {}; var statusMap = {STARTING: '准备执行', SUBMITTED: '任务已提交', RUNNING: '执行中', SUCCEEDED: '执行成功', FAILED: '执行失败'}; function phaseText(value) { if (value === 'SUCCEEDED') return '执行成功'; if (value === 'FAILED') return '执行失败'; if (value === 'RUNNING') return '执行中'; if (value === 'PENDING') return '等待执行'; return value || '未知'; } function displayValue(value) { if (value == null) return ''; if (typeof value === 'object') return value.message || value.result || value.path || '已生成'; return String(value); } data.executeStatusText = statusMap[data.executeStatus] || data.executeStatus || '已决策'; var raw = data.executionResult || ''; var parsed = null; if (raw && typeof raw === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) {} } data.hasStructuredResult = !!(parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)); var nodes = data.hasStructuredResult && Array.isArray(parsed.nodes) ? parsed.nodes : []; var outputs = data.hasStructuredResult && parsed.outputs && typeof parsed.outputs === 'object' ? parsed.outputs : {}; data.resultSummaryStatusText = data.hasStructuredResult ? (statusMap[parsed.status] || parsed.status || data.executeStatusText) : data.executeStatusText; data.resultSummaryNodeCount = nodes.length; data.resultSummarySuccessCount = nodes.filter(function(node) { return node && node.phase === 'SUCCEEDED'; }).length; data.resultSummaryOutputCount = Object.keys(outputs).length; data.nodeSummaryText = nodes.map(function(node) { var name = node.displayName || node.nodeId || '未命名节点'; var duration = node.executionDurationMs == null ? '' : '，耗时 ' + node.executionDurationMs + ' ms'; return name + '：' + phaseText(node.phase) + duration; }).join(' | '); data.outputSummaryText = Object.keys(outputs).map(function(key) { return key + '：' + displayValue(outputs[key]); }).join(' | '); data.resultMessage = data.hasStructuredResult ? (parsed.message || parsed.error || '') : ''; data.resultPlainText = data.hasStructuredResult ? '' : String(raw || '当前尚未生成执行结果'); return {...payload, status: payload.status === 200 ? 0 : payload.status, msg: payload.message, data: data};
